name: Chase Freedom Flex® Credit Card

apr.notes: 0% intro APR for the first 15 months on purchases and balance transfers; variable APRs are based on the Prime Rate.

fx_fee.notes: Foreign transaction fee is 3% of each transaction in U.S. dollars.

credit_required.notes: Approval is based on creditworthiness and other factors; Chase does not publish a score band.

base_rate.description: 1% cash back on all other purchases

categories.label: Dining at restaurants, including takeout and eligible delivery services

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash Back rewards are tracked as points; $1 in Cash Back rewards equals 100 points. Points do not expire while the account is open.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 20,000 bonus points, redeemable for $200 cash back, after spending $500 on purchases in the first 3 months from account opening.

benefits.title: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers eligible new purchases against damage or theft for 120 days from purchase, up to $500 per item.

details.conditions: Specific limitations apply to New York residents; see Chase terms.

benefits.title: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends eligible U.S. manufacturer warranties of three years or less by an additional year.

benefits.title: Trip Cancellation and Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $1,500 per covered traveler and $6,000 per trip for eligible prepaid, non-refundable passenger fares.

benefits.title: Auto Rental Coverage
benefits.description: Secondary reimbursement for theft and collision damage on most rental vehicles when the full rental cost is charged to the card and the rental company's collision insurance is declined.

benefits.title: Travel and Emergency Assistance
benefits.description: Provides legal and medical referrals and access to travel and emergency assistance services while traveling away from home; cardmembers pay for goods or services obtained.

benefits.title: DoorDash DashPass
benefits.description: Six months of complimentary DashPass for DoorDash and Caviar when activated by December 31, 2027; automatic paid enrollment applies after the complimentary period unless canceled.

benefits.title: DoorDash non-restaurant order discount
benefits.description: DashPass members can get up to $10 off one qualifying non-restaurant DoorDash order each calendar quarter through December 31, 2027.

notes: Offer details, APRs, and promotional rewards can change; verify on official Chase pages before publishing comparisons.
